consequence.statement: Monitoring systems scraping the `cilium_api_limiter_processed_requests_total` metric will receive an additional `return_code` label on each metric series, which may require updating metric queries and dashboards.

original.statement: The `cilium_api_limiter_processed_requests_total` metric now includes a `return_code` label to specify the HTTP code of the request.

decision.reason: [ev-af23565ba695] lists this under '1.16 Upgrade Notes › Changed Metrics' and says only that `cilium_api_limiter_processed_requests_total` now has a `return_code` label. Nothing in it says the metric is removed or renamed, or that anything stops working. The metric keeps being exported and only gains a new label, so behavior-change, which means review, is the right kind. The statement's hedged 'may require updating queries and dashboards' does not claim mandatory work.
